verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken crop. The photo is zoomed into the lower half of the face, so the eyes are cut off. The lightbulb, question-mark and atom doodles are piled on top of the mouth and cheek, which collides with the subject. The tiny 'PODCAST WITH' subtitle sits in a cramped side column next to the headline instead of underneath it. A leaves a slightly bigger gap between the atom doodle and 'HOW IT WORKS?'. In B the atom crowds the headline and the question mark covers more of the teeth.
